rationale: The agent authenticated the user and accessed the correct order, but then canceled the order without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user’s request was conditional (try split payment; if not, remove the most expensive item; if not, switch to cheapest options; if not, cancel), and the agent did not explore or confirm any of those steps before proceeding to cancellation. The stated cancellation reason (“ordered by mistake”) does not match the user’s situation. The agent also provided specific refund details and card last four without showing tool outputs confirming those details. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
